args.title: Summary: Retail Returns Logistics (Saltmarsh blog + companion piece)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns and its companion piece at https://insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion:

- Apparel return rates reached 24%, per the main article.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (~20%).
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin (companion piece).
